findings.title: Calendar dates shift by one day
findings.notes: Chrome entered the distinctive calendar date 2026-03-30 through the deployed external-shareholder UI in America/Los_Angeles; The deployed API rejected the save before creating a holder and the UI reported Pitch changed publication state while this shareholder change was being saved; A fresh-page recovery attempt reproduced the same optimistic-concurrency rejection; No holder was created and no cleanup or password restoration was required; The date-shift assertion could not be reached after the single bounded blocker-removal attempt

findings.title: Session emails contain wrong duration and destination
findings.notes: A real deployed session was created successfully with subject PIT-F017 duration and destination 1789752148378, session ID 6aad73626b8d9dde2f77d145, and duration 600 seconds (10 minutes).; The deployed notification contract sends session-scheduled email only to interested pitch followers; it does not send this message to the Pitcher host who created the session.; The controlled Pitcher Gmail account therefore was not a valid recipient and correctly contained no matching message after exact-subject and full-message searches.; No controlled mailbox for an interested Investor recipient was available in the established Chrome profiles, so the rendered duration and session CTA could not be verified without fabricating evidence.; No existing-user password was changed; the created test session remains in the mutable test environment.

findings.title: Completed assessment link opens an editable blank form

findings.title: Historical wallet presentation changes or misstates entries
findings.notes: The deployed wallet stability control passed: the historical marketplace debit retained identical amount, running balance, counterparty, and type across a full Chrome reload.; The consolidated defect specifically requires a new hold followed by release and a comparison proving the earlier ledger presentation remains unchanged after the later entry.; Creating that exact run-scoped state needs either a fully eligible two-actor transaction chain or direct development fixture seeding; the bounded environment-access attempt is blocked by interactive gcloud reauthentication.; No wallet record or user password was changed during this classification.

findings.title: Agreement preview overlaps at laptop sizes

findings.title: Agreement email link becomes empty after promotion
findings.notes: The controlled Pitcher Gmail contains historical shareholder-agreement notifications, proving mailbox readback is now available, but those messages predate the current deployed fix and cannot validate it.; The controlled Pitcher opened the current agreement but signing was correctly rejected because its template had not been initiated.; After one Investor-session refresh, the controlled Investor opened the same pitch successfully but was not the accepted-bid investor and therefore had no agreement to initiate or sign.; The exact current agreement counterparty actor is unavailable, so no new deployed notification could be generated and its CTA could not be verified without claiming stale historical email as current evidence.; No agreement transition or user password change occurred.

findings.title: Grant status and approval prompts contradict lifecycle

findings.title: Activation dashboard CTA reaches root

findings.title: Grant emails omit context or address the wrong role
findings.notes: A fresh public grant PIT-F036 email context 1789754608029 and two real applications were created with isolated controlled actors; application 6aad7da76b8d9dde2f7854c3 used the controlled Pitcher Gmail plus-address.; The real Grant Published email was delivered to the grant creator and greeted the account as Dear Test Pitcher, not Dear Admin; it included the unique grant title, type, funding threshold, grant ID, and a View grant details CTA.; The real Grant Application Update email was delivered to cic.test.pitcher+pitf035-1789754330@gmail.com and greeted the applicant as Dear PITF035 Fixture.; The rejection email included the exact applicant-facing reason PIT-F036 reason: documentation does not reconcile to the requested amount 1789754781, along with the unique grant title, application ID, applicant name/type, status, and View grant CTA.; The established Investor's in-app notification independently showed the same grant title and its exact applicant-facing rejection reason in deployed Chrome.; No existing user's password was changed; the one-time login code used for the isolated fixture was consumed and is not retained in evidence.

findings.title: Feedback SLA date shifts to the prior local day

findings.title: Support actionable count includes terminal records

findings.title: Registration data does not reach the assessor readiness surface

findings.title: Email verification gives no success confirmation — reproduced here on an Assessor identity (third occurrence overall)

findings.title: No warning before lockout

findings.title: No security notification of any kind is sent when an account is locked — no email and no in-app message

findings.title: Download Data produces a profile snapshot, not a complete portable personal-data export

findings.title: Account deactivation Submit becomes enabled with only a reason and static phrase

findings.title: Both logged-in Change Password and forgot-password recovery accept a canonical common password that the scenario explicitly requires to be rejected

findings.title: Expertise catalogue selection can create a mismatched area

findings.title: Impossible accomplishment year persists

findings.title: Employment date picker displays one year and saves another

findings.title: Unverified/KYC-incomplete Assessor is offered volunteer review despite an existing pitch relationship

findings.title: Review validation is bottom-only and does not focus invalid fields
findings.notes: Submitting an incomplete saved Review displayed a consolidated validation summary near the top of the form; The browser focus moved to the first invalid score or comment control; The focused invalid control was scrolled into the visible viewport; No submission occurred while required Review fields remained incomplete

findings.title: Recommendation options are bidding tactics rather than assessment conclusions
findings.notes: The deployed Review recommendation menu contains five assessment-conclusion options; Options cover recommend, conditional recommendation, evidence required, do not recommend, and unable to conclude; No option instructs the assessor to bid, outbid, delay a bid, seek equity, or use bargaining tactics

findings.title: The 1–5 rubric has no scale definitions
findings.notes: The deployed Review editor presents a visible rating-scale block before the category rubric; Every value from 1 through 5 has a distinct label and behavioral evidence definition; The copy explicitly states that higher scores mean stronger evidence and fewer material gaps

findings.title: Completed Review submits irreversibly without confirmation
findings.notes: A complete deployed Review did not submit immediately when the assessor clicked Submit; A confirmation dialog summarized category count, average score, recommendation, and notes; The dialog warned that the final review becomes requester-visible and cannot be edited; Submit final assessment remained disabled until the assessor acknowledged irreversibility; Cancelling returned to the still-editable draft without submission

findings.title: Submitted review's original draft URL still exposes Save and Submit
findings.notes: The complete Review was submitted only after confirming the irreversible action; The durable Review record changed from draft=true to draft=false; Reopening the exact original reviewId URL exposed neither Save as draft nor Submit; The submitted Review could not be reopened as editable work through the stale draft URL

findings.title: Empty and unchanged draft saves have no dirty-state guard
findings.notes: A completely empty new Review displayed No changes to save and disabled Save as draft; Changing one rating displayed an Unsaved changes indicator and enabled the save action; After saving, the UI displayed Draft saved and disabled the unchanged save action; Attempting the disabled action did not update the durable draft timestamp or create a redundant write

findings.title: Assessments-list resume opens an incompatible form and strands rubric data
findings.notes: The authoritative Draft row in Manage Assessments linked directly to the saved reviewId; Activating the list resume link opened the full Review rubric, not the generic non-Review response form; The previously saved first-category rating of 3 was restored; Save as draft remained available for the compatible Review editor

findings.title: Stale tab silently overwrites newer draft fields
findings.notes: Two Chrome tabs loaded the same saved Review draft revision; The first tab saved a newer category comment successfully; The stale second tab received an explicit conflict with Reload latest instead of overwriting; The durable value remained the newer first-tab value and Reload latest restored it in the stale tab

findings.title: Navigation discards unsaved draft edits without warning
findings.notes: Editing a saved Review displayed the explicit Unsaved changes state; Selecting Overview opened a browser confirmation explaining that unsaved assessment changes would be lost; Dismissing the prompt kept the same reviewId route and preserved the in-memory edit; Accepting the prompt navigated away, and reopening the draft restored the saved value rather than the discarded edit

findings.title: Exact duplicate RFIs are accepted as independent requests
findings.notes: The first RFI submission created one durable request and displayed an explicit success acknowledgement; Submitting the same title, description and due date returned an idempotent replay response referencing the original request ID; The duplicate submission reused the original request and exactly one matching RFI remained after reload and API verification

findings.title: Investor is offered a Pitcher signature control
findings.notes: Investor signature control is visible.; Pitcher signature control is absent for the Investor role.

findings.title: Summary counts disagree with empty history lists
findings.notes: The first Chrome attempt reached the login screen because the established Investor session had expired; no RFI was created.; The Investor session was refreshed successfully as the single bounded remediation attempt.; The rerun then remained on the application loading screen for 120 seconds and never received the project API response, so the count-to-row mutation could not be completed reliably.; No test data was changed during either attempt.

findings.title: Empty required grant details advance to setup
findings.notes: Empty required grant details remain on Step 1 of 2.; The form identifies missing title, positive amount, and purpose in a summary and inline errors.; Grant Setup is not rendered after the invalid Next action.

findings.title: Mobile drawer cannot reach Deactivate Profile
findings.notes: The 390x844 account drawer is independently scrollable.; Deactivate Profile becomes visible without moving the underlying page.; Selecting Deactivate Profile opens the account-closure dialog.

findings.title: Non-anonymous signup fails on null alias and emits duplicate confirmation mail
findings.notes: The non-anonymous Investor path exposed no Alias input.; The single submitted Investor payload contained bidAnonymously=false and omitted the alias property.; The deployed signup API returned HTTP 422 with message 'Alias already exists'.; The UI remained on Investor Registration and displayed 'Alias already exists', reproducing the original null-alias collision.; No account was created; confirmation-email side effects were not assessed because the primary blocking failure reproduced.

findings.title: Notification navigation badge remains stale after mark-read
findings.notes: Before mark-read: page=3500, navigation=3500.; Marked 8 visible notifications read.; Immediately after: page=3492, navigation=3492.; After reload: page=3492, navigation=3492.

findings.title: Failed withdrawal does not release its reservation
findings.notes: The live Investor wallet loaded with available balance NGN 4,183,090.83 and current balance NGN 11,238,910.83.; All three existing linked NGN accounts were payout-pending and unavailable for withdrawal.; The bounded fixture-remediation attempt selected Guaranty Trust Bank and submitted a valid 10-digit test account to POST /api/v1/bank-accounts/paystack/verify.; The deployed API returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, so no payout-ready account or withdrawal was created and the failed-withdrawal reservation-release branch could not be exercised.; No wallet balance or test data changed.

findings.title: Withdrawal quote total excludes its displayed fee
findings.notes: Withdrawal amount: NGN 10000.00.; Displayed wallet withdrawal fee: NGN 53.24.; Displayed total reserved: NGN 10053.24.; The displayed total equals withdrawal amount plus the displayed fee.

findings.title: Cancelled sessions still offer Join live room
findings.notes: The cancelled deployed session returned HTTP 200 to its Pitcher host and invited Investor; Both roles saw SESSION UNAVAILABLE and the explicit session re-entry disabled explanation; Neither role had a Join live room control and neither browser emitted a live-room join request

findings.title: Reschedule email converts 30 minutes to 1800 minutes
findings.notes: A deployed session was created with a stored duration of 1,800 seconds and successfully rescheduled; The actual transactional email arrived in the existing public Yopmail-backed test inbox; Chrome rendered the email duration as 30 minutes; The delivered email did not contain the incorrect phrase 1800 minutes

findings.title: Distribution form reports no available profit in the wrong currency
findings.notes: The deployed project API exposes 100 of verified distributable profit in USD; The Investor dividend form renders Available funds = USD 100; The form does not substitute the Investor viewer currency (NGN or ₦) for the project-wallet currency

findings.title: Incoming financial receipts reverse sender and recipient
findings.notes: A real dividend motion crossed the 51% threshold and executed against the deployed USD project; The Investor ledger shows the incoming USD 24.95 dividend from project kkkkk; The dividend receipt identifies kkkkk / Project wallet as sender and CIC Investor / Personal wallet as recipient; The existing grant disbursement receipt identifies the grant wallet as sender and CIC Investor personal wallet as recipient

findings.title: Counteroffer terminates negotiation without an Investor response path
findings.notes: The Investor saw the Pitcher's revised USD 1113 / 0.09% terms in deployed Chrome; The dialog exposed Accept, Reject, and Counter responses; Submitting unchanged terms produced the required inline validation error; Changing the amount to USD 1063 submitted a new Investor-authored counteroffer

findings.title: Expired pending bid remains active and keeps funds reserved
findings.notes: The live pending bid reserved USD 1000 without reducing current balance; After its real expiry and a deployed page reload, the bid moved to history with Expired status; The persisted bid status is expired, expiredOn is set, and reservedAmount is zero; The Investor pending and available wallet balances returned exactly to their pre-bid values

findings.title: Pitch preference state is contradictory and Favourites filtering is inaccurate
findings.notes: Liking the pitch persisted it only in favouritedPitches; Disliking the same pitch atomically removed it from favourites and persisted it only in dislikedPitches; The exclusive dislike state survived a full page reload; After removing the reaction, the Favourites filter excluded the exact pitch while retaining unrelated favourites

findings.title: Follow and unfollow totals remain stale until identity handoff
findings.notes: Unfollow changed the visible target total from 1 to 0 immediately; The unfollowed state and decremented total persisted after a full reload; Follow changed the visible target total back to 1 immediately; The deployed API follower array agreed with every visible state transition

findings.title: Successful profile report renders a blank acknowledgement toast
findings.notes: The deployed API returned the meaningful acknowledgement: Profile report already submitted.; The success alert rendered that non-blank acknowledgement in Chrome; A durable confidential report reference and status rendered on the profile; The acknowledgement exposed a Track in Feedback link

findings.title: Investor project wallet falsely displays zero balance and no ledger
findings.notes: The shareholder-authorized deployed API returned the funded USD project wallet; The UI displayed USD 999.99 available/current balance rather than zero; The project funding, verified profit, and dividend debit all rendered in the ledger; The visible ledger amounts agreed with the deployed transaction payload

findings.title: Project Equity omits other CIC shareholders and contradicts funded ownership
findings.notes: The shareholder view displayed the Investor's 49.91% stake; It separately displayed 50.08% for all other CIC shareholders combined; Non-CIC equity displayed 0%; Other shareholder identities and raw user IDs were not exposed

findings.title: Owner cannot create a milestone using selectable valid dates
findings.notes: The owner opened Add Milestone and selected September 17, 2026 from the rendered date picker; The deployed API accepted the selected date and created the completed milestone; The milestone appeared immediately and persisted after a full reload; The persisted card rendered Achieved on Sep 17, 2026

findings.title: Milestone comment validation and Unicode recovery silently lose input
findings.notes: Whitespace-only text stayed in the dialog and showed Comment text is required without an API request; A unique internationalised comment containing CJK text, an accented character and emoji received one successful API response; The API returned exactly one persisted comment with the Unicode text unchanged; The Unicode comment rendered in the discussion and remained after a full reload

findings.title: Owner and unrelated Investor can mutate milestone review state
findings.notes: The Pitcher owner saw no Support or Push back controls on the owner-created milestone; The owner therefore had no rendered path to inflate approval or rejection signals on the owner-created milestone; The unrelated-Investor half could not be completed after the one allowed setup attempt because login-code verification did not establish a reusable Chrome session; The existing unrelated Investor password was restored immediately after the setup attempt

findings.title: Required milestone delivery and acceptance lifecycle is absent
findings.notes: The Pitcher created a planned milestone with a due date and moved it to active; The Pitcher submitted revision 1 with durable delivery evidence and an audit note; The shareholder Investor saw the submitted state and evidence and accepted delivery with a decision note; Accepted status, 100% progress, revision 1, evidence and decision history all persisted after reload; Exactly three deployed lifecycle mutations completed successfully: start, submit and accept

findings.title: Valid project RFI submission is silently lost
findings.notes: The shareholder submitted a unique operational RFI containing CJK text, an accented character and emoji; The deployed API returned HTTP 200 with the exact title, Unicode description and category; The UI displayed an explicit Information request submitted acknowledgement and the new row; The RFI title, category and Unicode description remained visible after a full reload

findings.title: Project RFI follow-up, acknowledgment and reopen lifecycle is absent
findings.notes: The owner responded twice to the same RFI, with revision advancing from 1 to 2; The requesting Investor sent a follow-up that reopened the workflow for another owner response; The requesting Investor acknowledged response v2, explicitly closed the request and reopened it; Category, status, revision, ordered private thread entries and audit timestamps remained visible after reload; All six deployed response/lifecycle mutations returned HTTP 200

findings.title: Whitespace-only project RFI response closes and persists blank
findings.notes: Whitespace-only response text stayed in the dialog and showed Response Message Cannot be empty; No deployed API mutation occurred for the whitespace-only attempt and the RFI stayed open; A padded substantive response was trimmed, persisted exactly once and changed status to responded; The substantive response, responded status and revision 3 remained visible after reload

findings.title: Required governance-report obligation, review and revision lifecycle is absent
findings.notes: The Pitcher created, saved and submitted a real governance report with a due obligation through the deployed UI; The shareholder Investor acknowledged, accepted, reopened and requested correction with an audit note; The Pitcher created a correction revision, changed its health summary and submitted the revised report; The Investor saw immutable revision comparison, changed-section and audit-history evidence, then accepted and reopened the revision; The reopened revision and full review state persisted after a real page reload, and export remained available
